profile.geoLocationName: Jersey City, New Jersey, United States
profile.summary:
Software Engineer with experience building and modernizing enterprise web applications, now expanding deeper into AI engineering, application security, and secure AI adoption.

My background spans full-stack development, front-end architecture, Agile delivery, technical mentorship, dependency hygiene, static analysis, and secure development practices.

I’m especially interested in the intersection of software engineering, cybersecurity, and AI-enabled development: helping teams adopt modern tools and workflows while maintaining strong judgment around risk, governance, and maintainability.

Currently, I’m building an AI engineering project focused on turning an ambiguous business workflow into a secure, evaluated, and human-reviewed software system. The work combines full-stack development, product thinking, AI-assisted workflow design, governance controls, evaluation discipline, and auditability. The goal is to demonstrate that I can define a real user problem, scope an MVP, make product trade-offs, build the technical system, and explain how responsible AI can be applied inside enterprise-style applications.

I’m also pursuing a Master’s in Cybersecurity, with a long-term focus on AI governance, application security, secure AI integration, and risk-conscious engineering.
